subject: Proto error (using ggplot2) on Windows 7 64 bits

messages.author: fc22cb727156ff4f
messages.subject: Proto error (using ggplot2) on Windows 7 64 bits
parts:
Hi Hadley and all,

A current install of ggplot on Windows 7 64 bits gives me this:

> library("ggplot2")
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) :
cannot open file
'C:/Users/Leila/Documents/R/win-library/2.13/proto/R/proto.rdb': No
such file or directory
In addition: Warning message:
In eval(expr, envir, enclos) : restarting interrupted promise evaluation
Error : unable to load R code in package 'ggplot2'
Error: package/namespace load failed for 'ggplot2'

The R installation is completely standard and the only thing I did was
install a few packages (ggplot, plyr, mass). Any idea where that comes
from? Is there a chance the dev version is better in this respect (I
know you reduced the use of proto)?

Thanks in advance,

JiHO
